text: Hello, this is Aham Shah, I'm the founder of K.Tablesh Electric and this is a demonstration of our communication infrastructure where you can talk to any legacy energy asset, any rechargeer, inverter, battery, transformers using standard protocols where you can have you can vote any legacy protocol and integrate to the open standard requirements that are growing in California, Texas, India, Australia and many more. We will start by showcasing you a gateway product where you can connect any asset to a physical product or you can also issue a license on your existing physical device and then there's a third product where we do OEM integrations where it's a standard API access. We will showcase all three to you. The idea is we can throw out the API access today, help them bring them to the open standards tomorrow or if they're ready for open standards we can throw out that immediately as well. Let's showcase you the edge portal. As you can see this is running on the edge and that we have no northbound connect, which means that you have a lot of potential southbound devices, a lot of different protocols. We can convert any of them into a standard northbound protocol and that's called IHPLE 2030.5. So we'll connect our southbound device and once it's connected to a northbound we can see telemetry and then control the device. That's the infrastructure that we want to enable and this infrastructure can enable a lot of other services. Right now we see that the northbound is not connected so let's fix that. This is our mobile application that our utility or OEM will provide to the customers to log in. So let's do a customer login here. We can log into the device. You can look for devices that you can enroll and through Bluetooth you can define devices or you can physically also look for devices that you want to connect to. You can select the device that you want to connect to. Let's call this battery asset demo and now our certificate is being issued to the client that's sitting on the edge. So your gateway itself is being connected. Now this gateway can enable you to connect to more devices. While the certificate is being issued let me show you what the utility portal looks like. We just saw the customer side of it on the phone for a utility. They want to be able to control these assets and that is where our product is crucial. But today they want to control and manage their customers, manage assets and using that provide various grid services. These grid services are in your forecasting, procurement records, your trading, many many more. For the infrastructure you want to provide lies right here. But how can you connect to any asset that's on the grid? So that is where our product comes into play. So here you can see battery asset demo. The commission has been completed. So we can see the product here. At the same time, we can see that the northbound is now connected. Towards southbound now let's add a device. Let's call it a suspect. The suspect is one of the early standards right now. So that's been approved. You can see it in our DR management portal. We are currently bringing a device onboard. So we are running a simulated telemetry. You will see that now. Currently the battery is at a 65% state of charge. You can see that we just got a force data point from the battery. So now let's go into the grid portal and look for the same. And there we have it. We can see that the best that we just onboarded is visible here. So first you'll get away and then a best one battery asset. You can also add other assets like your inverter, like your meter to the same gateway. Here we can see the first data point that is at 65% charge. So that's your telemetry. That's one half of what you really would want to do. The second half is you want to control the asset. So here we are providing universal control for any asset where for your battery, let's say you want to discharge an event one. So you will discharge a battery for a duration of five minutes. So you've created the event. The event will get registered here. And this entire demo is from perspective of one asset. However, we can do this at a population scale where once you can do this for millions of assets, that's when you can create grid services. And we are ready to do that today. So we can see that the event has been registered. Let's go back to our edge portal, the device where we are reading telemetry and the response should show you. And there we have a response now that the battery as of a few seconds ago has started discharging. It took seconds for the battery to respond, which is extremely crucial for a battery to be able to participate in various auxiliary and frequency markets. This is our demonstration for the KWH communications infrastructure. And as we move forward, you want to enable intelligence on the edge. We want to work with our own models, use the data to train models that will sit worth on the edge and on the utility side. We're also working on grid services where our expertise lies in flexibility and forecasting, which we have already demonstrated through our previous work. And we can provide a lot of other grid services. Thank you so much for your time and we look forward to talking to you.
